The Friends' Notebook.

What do people actually think about Anushka when she's not looking? Discover the real words.

Akshaj

"A Message to Laali 💄"

Anushka ek bohot pyaari ladki hai vo itni acchi hai ki uski taareef ke liye mere paas shabd hi nhi hai. Agar koi merese kisi random person ki taareef krne ko kehta to mai aisa kuch bol kr khtm kr deta 🙃🙃

But yaha jis ladki ki baat ho rhi hai vo meri life ki One of the Kindest, Helping, Caring, Supporting and The Purest girl hai jo maine apne life mai dekhi ho. The only one jiska movie taste merese match krta hai jo saari mujhe movies pasand hai is bandi ne kahi na kahi vo saari dekhi hoti hai — From Romantic to Horror to even TV shows like Brooklyn Nine-Nine, The Office. Anushka pehli thi jisne ye saare shows dekhe ho and mujhe abhi bhi yaad hai bus mai jab hum log Vampire Diaries ki baat kr rhe the to jab usne kaha ki uska favourite character Stefan hai I was like "Finally!!! Koi mila mujhe aisa jiske saath mujhe itna relatable feel hua ho."

Usually jab log zyada haste hai ya expression show krte hai to vo aisa lgta hai ki overacting kr rhe hai, but Anushka ke case mai kabhi aisa nhi lgta. Uska harr reaction aur expression itna pure, cute and real lgta hai ki kabhi kabhi situation se zyada funny uske reactions hote hai. Anushka group ke un kuch logo mai se aati hai jinka mood agar sahi ho to poore group ka mood accha rehta hai. Jab bhi Anushka bakchodi ke form mai hoti hai, poore raste sab enjoy krte hue jaate hai.

And as for caring and supporting: mujhe aaj bhi yaad hai jab Rishikesh ke trip ki planning ho rhi thi and maine btaya tha ki mujhe gharwalon se paise maangna nhi pasand so I have to earn that from somewhere. Us time to kaafi logo ne mujhe accha feel krane ke liye kuch na kuch kaha, but Anushka was the only one jisne ghar jaake specially alag se msg kra mujhe telling me ki "chinta na kro kuch na kuch dekh lenge, mai bhi kuch na kuch dekhti hu tumhare liye". And sirf vo hi nhi, aise bohot saare incidents hue hai jaha Anushka ne ye dikhaya hai ki how much she cares for her people. Like Friendship Day pe bhi she was the only one jisne mujhe msg krke wish kra ho, and vo chhote chhote efforts mujhe itne acche lagte the ki I have made some really good friends in my college.

Anushka ka nature hi aisa hai: dusro ki dikkat mai jitna supportive, utna hi jab apni dikkat aaye to shaant. Kabhi apne mood ka effect dusro pe nhi padne deti, and jab bhi usko udaas dekhta hu to kahi na kahi mujhe bhi bohot bura lagta hai. Vo feeling hoti hai na ki yr itne acche aur pyaare logo ke saath buri cheezein hoti hi kyu hai, like they deserve to be the happiest people.

Anushka ke saath maine kaafi saare unforgettable memories banayi hai, jaise vo metro mai travel krna vo meri life ke sabse exciting adventures mai aata hai. And mera personal favourite tab tha jab 2nd semester over hone ke baad hum log ke summer vacations start hone vaale the and us din jab hum log bus se vapas aa rhe the to Para pahuchte time jab maine dekha ki Laali roo rhi thi... it was such a beautiful moment jab hum sab phir usko hug krke hasane ka try krne lag gye the. Us din bus se utarne ke baad jab mai ghar vapas jaa rha tha with a smile on my face, mere dimaag mai yahi chal rha tha ki I am really lucky jo meri college ki starting mai hi mujhe aise friends mile.

So Laali humesha khush rha kro kyuki tumhari vo energy poore bus mai reflect hoti hai and I am really lucky to have a friend like you in my life 🧿. I wish ki mai tere liye aur bhi kaafi saari cheezein kr paau jisse tere chehre pe smile aajaaya kre, and maine shayad kabhi tumhe ek proper Thank You nhi bola for all the things that you have done for me so Thank Youu 🫂. Always remember tu aise sad acchi nhi lgti, so always keep that smile on your face 🧿.

The Reveal Connection
Remember when the earlier chapter said: "Somehow knows when someone is quietly struggling"? Akshaj experienced it firsthand when she texted him in private after everyone else had moved on.

Ammar

"One of the best behen i ever had"

"One of the best behen i ever had is Anushka. Yrr itni cool h woh ki kya hi kahun.

I still remember ki yr jab hum games khelte the toh uska participation kitna zyada accha lagta tha. Bohot hi mast positive vibe aati thi. Kitni zyada movies pata h yr usko. Aur yr kitne zyada maze se baat karte the hum sab.

Bilkul hi free hoke openly kuch bhi bol sakte h yr usse. And the best part is ki woh sab samjhti h aur acche se batati bhi h. Specially jab main galat ladki ke peeche padh gya. Aur hn mera breakup ho chuka h isbar sacchi wala. Tbh one of the closest girl i’ve ever had the interaction.

Aur mazak toh hn hum sab karte hi h. Kyunki bakchod toh hum sab h 😂

But yr seriously i trust her so much even in my sad times she used to joke around and make me smile. Aaj tak tujhse kabhi bhi jhuth nhi bolna padha thats what shows ki how much comfortable im with you. Thanks behen for being there in my life. Love you so much ! Main humesha hoon tere liye."

The Reveal Connection
"You never have to pretend around her." Ammar's words reveal how her presence makes people drop their guards and speak their truth freely.

Arnima

"“Agar kuch bhi ho toh batana”"

"Anushka, honestly mujhe samajh nahi aa raha kaise likhu bina awkward hue but I just wanted to say ki I genuinely really appreciate you.

I remember all those random conversations, crazy moments, stupid laughs and all those little things we've done together with everyone, and honestly I don't think I forget them that easily.

I also remember how you've always helped me whenever I've reached out to you, especially that day when I was crying and you kept asking me if I was okay and said “agar kuch bhi ho toh batana”. I still remember that.

And thank you for tolerating me too because my timing is genuinely horrible, main wrong situation mein has deti hoon aur wrong time pe serious ho jaati hoon 😭.

But jokes apart, I really admire how bold and fearless you are, and I just wish you would tell me too whenever something bothers you or you're hurt. You don't always have to handle everything alone. You've been there for me, so just know that I'm here for you too. And honestly, I just like seeing you happy because you look way too good when you're smiling."

The Reveal Connection
Arnima hits the heart of the truth: The girl who always asks "are you okay?" shouldn't have to carry her own battles in isolation.

Pragati

"Bus mein mile log & 'Dhyan rakhna' ❤️"

"Anushkaa, pata hai bus mein mile hue log kab itne apne ban jaate hain, pata hi nahi chalta. 🥺❤️ Aur tum unhi logon mein se hai jo dheere-dheere dil ke bahut close ho jaate hain.

Tumhara nature mujhe genuinely bahut achha lagta hai. Tum sabki help karti ho, kisi ko sad dekhti hai toh bina soche pooch leti hai ki “kya hua?” Aur agar tumhara khud ka mood kharab ho, toh bhi tum kisi ko pata nahi chalne deti. 🥺

Tum agar kisi se hate bhi karti ho, phir bhi agar woh kisi problem mein ho toh uski fikr karna nahi bhoolti aur “dhyan rakhna” zaroor bolti hai. ❤️ Honestly, ye cheez tmko aur bhi achaa banati hai.

Bas meri ek baat yaad rakhna jis tarah tum sabke liye khadi rehti ho, waise hi hum bhi tumhare liye hamesha khade hain. 🫂 Agar kabhi kuch dikkat ho, mann kharab ho, kisi se kuch share karna ho ya bas bina kisi reason ke baat karni ho, toh humare paas aa jana. Tumhe sab kuch khud se handle karne ki zarurat nahi hai.

Aur haan, bus ki ye chhoti-chhoti conversations, hasi-mazaak aur saath mein aana-jaana shayad normal lage, but ye sab matter krta hai bohot yahi sab memories hongii. 🥺❤️ I’m genuinely glad ki mujhe tumhari jaisi dost mili. Bas aise hi rehna, kyunki tum jaisi ho na, bahut pyaari hai. 🫶🏻🫂"

The Reveal Connection
"Even if you dislike someone, you never forget to say 'dhyan rakhna' when they are hurt." That is pure, undeniable character.
